findings: Bounded causal support is strong: Java ITFLeaf.drawU calls box.drawU at the supplied origin; ITFComposed alone uses getw1. Rust main_w/2 cancels its center subtraction for leaves and retains node.w1 for composed nodes. No spacing/topology algorithm or numeric compensation changed.

Fresh leaf_tiny_many (six siblings on both sides), leaf_deep (depth five), and leaf_sizes (sizes6/29/9 with bold) all pass whole output after failing before. The source-defined unboxed margins and the leaf origin generalize beyond the original tiny empty control.

Whole-output acceptance is nevertheless rejected: s_leaf_commands is 103x144 in both renderers with matching positions, but empty size/color commands merge q/r into qr. s_leaf_escapes retains backslashes before tildes and widens components. These fail before and after and are shared-text dependencies; no new defect in the leaf-origin arithmetic was demonstrated. A supported local invariant is not a waiver of the requested whole-output gate.
